title: Umuriro Uboneka Kure
intro: Iyumvire ikiyaya c’umwiza mw’ijoro, umuco wo kure uriko uraca ibibatsi ku kirere, n’umugenzi ari wenyene ariko aragenda yerekeza kuri uwo muco arondera ubuyobozi, gusa akarungikwa n’ubutumwa bwo guhangana n’ubwami no kubohora ihanga ryahahazwa.
clues: Nashizwe mu mazi nk’uruyoya mu gasandugu ku ruzi n’ivyiyumviro vya Allah kuri mawe.
Nakuriye mu rugo nyene rw’umunyagitugu yahahaza abantu banje.
Narahunga inyuma y’ugutongana kwari kwishe maze mara imyaka i Madyan ndagira imikuku kugira ngo nkoreshe.
Nabonye umuriro iruhande y’umusozi, nca mpamagarwa n’ijwi rivuye mu mwonga uhezagiwe.
Nahawe ibimenyetso bibiri bikomeye mu biganza vyanje: inkoni yahindutse inzoka n’ukuboko kwakayangana kwera cane.
Nahagaze na musazanje imbere y’umutware wa Misiri, mu nyuma mbona ikiyaga gica ibice bibiri kugira ngo dushobore guhunga.

options: Yahamagawe na Allah ku kiyaya c'umuhezagiro, yoherezwa kuri Farawoni .

trial.answer: Yahamagawe na Allah ku kiyaya c'umuhezagiro, yoherezwa kuri Farawoni .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Ingabo za Farawoni zirarohama maze bene Isirayeli bararokoka .
outcome.answer: Ingabo za Farawoni zirarohama maze bene Isirayeli bararokoka .
